note: Labels and descriptions for coded values in the Data Center Atlas datasets. Each vocabulary maps a code to {label, description}. Codes found in a dataset but missing here fall back to a title-cased code. Statuses describe the last reported project status on the evidence date.

lead.label: Lead
lead.description: Unverified lead about a possible project, kept in the research queue.

candidate.label: Candidate
candidate.description: Candidate project under research. Research pipeline status only; no construction claim.

announced.label: Announced
announced.description: A dated primary source identifies the proposed data-centre project. Construction has not been established.

proposed.label: Proposed
proposed.description: A proposed development; announcement, permission or physical work is not established.

site_control.label: Site control
site_control.description: The developer was reported to control the site, for example by purchase or lease. No physical work is claimed.

permitting.label: Permitting
permitting.description: Permits were being sought. No physical work is claimed.

permitted.label: Permitted
permitted.description: Issued consent covers the data-centre development identified in the record. The authority, decision date and approved work are recorded; construction is established separately.

site_preparation.label: Site preparation
site_preparation.description: A dated authoritative source reported site preparation, such as clearing, grading or enabling works, as of the status date.

clearing.label: Clearing
clearing.description: A dated source reported land clearing as of the status date.

civil_works.label: Civil works
civil_works.description: A dated authoritative source reported civil works, such as earthworks, drainage, roads or utility connections, as of the status date.

foundations.label: Foundations
foundations.description: A dated authoritative source reported foundation work as of the status date.

shell.label: Shell
shell.description: A dated authoritative source reported work on the building shell or structure as of the status date.

mep_electrical.label: MEP / electrical
mep_electrical.description: A dated authoritative source reported mechanical, electrical and plumbing (MEP) or electrical installation work as of the status date.

under_construction.label: Under construction
under_construction.description: A dated authoritative source reported that construction was under way, without a more specific stage, as of the status date.

commissioning.label: Commissioning
commissioning.description: A dated authoritative source reported commissioning or testing before operation as of the status date. Not a claim that the facility is operating.

completed.label: Completed
completed.description: A dated primary source reports construction of the named project complete. Operation is established separately.

operational.label: Operational
operational.description: A dated primary source confirms that the facility was operating.

expansion.label: Expansion
expansion.description: A dated authoritative source reported physical expansion work at an existing facility as of the status date.

cancelled.label: Cancelled
cancelled.description: The project was reported as cancelled.

repurposed.label: Repurposed
repurposed.description: The site or building was reported as repurposed for another use.

decommissioned.label: Decommissioned
decommissioned.description: The facility was reported as decommissioned.

demolished.label: Demolished
demolished.description: The facility was reported as demolished.

partially_operational.label: Partially operational
partially_operational.description: Part of the project is operating; this does not establish completion of every phase.

attributed_firsthand_physical_status_rep.label: Firsthand project statement
attributed_firsthand_physical_status_rep.description: A named project participant's explicitly attributed physical-status statement in a reviewed news report. The publisher and original attribution remain recorded; government republication is not an inspection or certification.

authoritative_physical_status_update.label: Authoritative status update
authoritative_physical_status_update.description: A dated report from the developer, operator, contractor or government on the project's physical status.

authoritative_project_announcement.label: Project announcement
authoritative_project_announcement.description: A dated primary source announcing the named data-centre project.

authoritative_construction_permit.label: Development consent
authoritative_construction_permit.description: An issued government consent for the data-centre development, with its decision date and approved work recorded.

authoritative_construction_start.label: Authoritative construction start
authoritative_construction_start.description: A dated report from an authoritative source that construction started. Later progress is not implied.

government_record.label: Government record
government_record.description: A dated government record documenting the project's status, such as development consent, an inspection or a registry entry.

physical_observation.label: Physical observation
physical_observation.description: A dated, documented observation of physical work at the site.

imported_documented_status.label: Reported status
imported_documented_status.description: Status and observation date retained from the original project record; see its sources and scope.

official_boundary.label: Official boundary
official_boundary.description: An official parcel or surveyed boundary of the project site from an official source. It is a legal or permit boundary, not a building footprint or the extent of construction.

campus_locator.label: Campus locator
campus_locator.description: Geometry that locates the parent campus. It is not the project's footprint and does not show where on the campus work is happening.

project_locator.label: Project locator
project_locator.description: Geometry that locates the project, such as a source-published project point. It is not a footprint or a surveyed boundary.

reviewed_site_locator.label: Reviewed site locator
reviewed_site_locator.description: A reviewed point or shape that locates the physical site. It is not a footprint or a surveyed boundary.

host_estate_context.label: Host-estate context only
host_estate_context.description: Geometry of the industrial estate or business park that hosts the site, kept only as locality context. It does not locate the site or project within the estate: it is not a site locator, parcel, boundary, footprint or construction extent, and its display anchor is not a site position.

locality_context.label: Locality reference only
locality_context.description: The point identifies a town or locality, not the facility position.

admin2_context.label: County or district reference only
admin2_context.description: The point identifies a county or district, not the facility position.

admin1_context.label: State or region reference only
admin1_context.description: The point identifies a state or region, not the facility position.

approximate_site_locator.label: Approximate site reference
approximate_site_locator.description: Approximate facility position inherited from the cited record; not a surveyed location.

official_source.label: Official source
official_source.description: Published by a government authority or by a first-party source such as the developer or operator.

community_source.label: Community source
community_source.description: Taken from a community-maintained source, such as a named OpenStreetMap feature. Never treated as an official boundary.

community_mapped.label: Community mapped
community_mapped.description: Contributor-mapped geometry, such as an OpenStreetMap polygon, accepted only as a locator. Never treated as an official boundary.

compiled_reference.label: Compiled location reference
compiled_reference.description: Coordinates retained with the original source record precision. Administrative points do not locate the facility.

authoritative_project_record_plus_scoped.label: Reported project and sourced location
authoritative_project_record_plus_scoped.description: A dated primary project record and a sourced location with its scope recorded. The status and evidence date identify what is supported.

authoritative_physical_observation_plus_.label: Reported status and sourced location
authoritative_physical_observation_plus_.description: A dated authoritative physical-status observation and a reviewed location. Check status_as_of for its age. This does not claim independent imagery or on-site verification.

recent_authoritative_physical_observatio.label: Reported status and sourced location
recent_authoritative_physical_observatio.description: A dated authoritative physical-status observation and a reviewed location. Check status_as_of for its age. This does not claim independent imagery or on-site verification.

recent_authoritative_physical_observatio.label: Reported status and official boundary
recent_authoritative_physical_observatio.description: A dated authoritative physical-status observation and an official boundary. Check status_as_of for its age. This does not claim independent imagery or on-site verification.

recent_authoritative_physical_observatio.label: Reported status; surrounding estate only
recent_authoritative_physical_observatio.description: A dated authoritative physical-status observation, with a map of the surrounding estate rather than the site's position. Check status_as_of for its age. This does not claim independent imagery or on-site verification.

imported_source_record.label: Sourced project record
imported_source_record.description: Status, dates and location precision retained from the cited record; not independently reverified during consolidation.

mixed_review_postures.label: Multiple project sources
mixed_review_postures.description: The site contains projects with different source and location reviews; consult each project.

critical_it_mw.label: Critical IT load
critical_it_mw.description: Power available to IT equipment for the project scope at the stated stage. A planned or design value is not installed or operating capacity.

gross_facility_mw.label: Gross facility power
gross_facility_mw.description: Total facility power, including cooling and other loads, for the project scope at the stated stage.

grid_connection_mw.label: Grid connection
grid_connection_mw.description: Grid connection capacity for the project scope at the stated stage, for example requested, contracted or planned.

generation_nameplate_mw.label: Generation nameplate
generation_nameplate_mw.description: Nameplate capacity of on-site or dedicated generation at the stated stage.

annual_energy_mwh.label: Annual energy
annual_energy_mwh.description: Annual energy for the project scope. Published only from scoped observations; never estimated from capacity.

pue.label: PUE
pue.description: Power usage effectiveness (total facility energy divided by IT energy). A design value is not measured performance.

requested.label: Requested
requested.description: Capacity requested from a utility or authority; not granted or built.

contracted.label: Contracted
contracted.description: Capacity covered by an agreement such as a grid or power-purchase contract; not necessarily installed.

design.label: Design
design.description: Design capacity or value; not installed, energized or operating.

planned.label: Planned
planned.description: Planned capacity for the project scope; not installed, energized or operating.

installed.label: Installed
installed.description: Reported as installed; not necessarily energized or in use.

unknown.label: Unknown stage
unknown.description: The stage of the reported value is not established.

reported.label: Reported
reported.description: The value is reported by the source.

equipment_inference.label: Equipment inference
equipment_inference.description: Inferred from equipment records, such as generator or transformer orders.

certification_registry.label: Certification registry
certification_registry.description: A facility entry published by the certifying organization. Certification scope and dates do not by themselves establish an opening date or full-campus operation.

government_notice.label: Government notice
government_notice.description: A notice published by a government body. A lease award or announcement is distinct from permission to build and from achieved physical work.

map.label: Map feature
map.description: A feature from a map provider. The project record states the identity bridge, locator scope and provider terms; a marker is not a surveyed boundary.

government_record.label: Government record
government_record.description: A record published by a government body, such as a permit, planning, cadastral or registry record.

company_disclosure.label: Company disclosure
company_disclosure.description: A publication by the developer, operator, contractor or another company involved, such as a press release, project page or report.

utility_record.label: Utility record
utility_record.description: A record or announcement from a utility.

equipment_order.label: Equipment order
equipment_order.description: An equipment order or procurement record.

openstreetmap.label: OpenStreetMap
openstreetmap.description: An OpenStreetMap object (© OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL 1.0).

third_party_dataset.label: Third-party dataset
third_party_dataset.description: A record from a third-party dataset.

other.label: Other
other.description: Another kind of source, such as a technical specification used for coordinate handling.

commercial_directory_record.label: Commercial directory record
commercial_directory_record.description: An entry in a commercial data-centre directory.

company_facility_page.label: Company facility page
company_facility_page.description: A facility page published by the operator or developer.

company_facility_specification.label: Company facility specification
company_facility_specification.description: A facility specification published by the operator or developer.

government_address_register.label: Government address register
government_address_register.description: An entry in an official address register.

government_cadastral_api.label: Government cadastral API
government_cadastral_api.description: A record from an official cadastral (property) API.

government_cadastral_open_data.label: Government cadastral open data
government_cadastral_open_data.description: A record from official open cadastral data.

government_coordinate_transformation.label: Government coordinate transformation
government_coordinate_transformation.description: A result from an official coordinate transformation service.

government_event_project_locator.label: Government event project locator
government_event_project_locator.description: A project location published with an official government event notice.

government_municipal_project_map.label: Government municipal project map
government_municipal_project_map.description: A municipal project map or project page.

government_permit.label: Government permit
government_permit.description: A permit decision published by a government authority.

government_planning_record.label: Government planning record
government_planning_record.description: An official planning document or record.

government_registry.label: Government registry
government_registry.description: An entry in an official registry or facilities list.

government_statistical_boundary.label: Government statistical boundary
government_statistical_boundary.description: An official statistical-area boundary. It is not a site or parcel boundary.

open_dataset.label: Open dataset
open_dataset.description: A record from an open dataset, such as OpenStreetMap edit history.

open_map.label: Open map
open_map.description: An object from an open map such as OpenStreetMap.

open_map_geometry.label: Open map geometry
open_map_geometry.description: Geometry from an open map such as OpenStreetMap.

open_map_record.label: Open map record
open_map_record.description: A full record from an open map, such as an OpenStreetMap way with its nodes.

regulatory_filing.label: Regulatory filing
regulatory_filing.description: A regulatory filing, such as a securities filing.

analyst_report.label: Analyst report
analyst_report.description: Analysis published by a research organization.

utility_disclosure.label: Utility disclosure
utility_disclosure.description: Information published by an electricity or infrastructure utility.

announcement.label: Project announcement
announcement.description: Supports the announcement of the named data-centre project.

permit.label: Development consent
permit.description: Supports issued consent for the named data-centre development and identifies the approved work.

physical_status.label: Physical status
physical_status.description: Source of the project's last observed physical status.

geometry.label: Geometry
geometry.description: Source of the published locator or boundary geometry.

context:identity.label: Site and project identity
context:identity.description: Connects the named project, campus or facility to the record. Does not establish construction status.

context:power_readiness.label: Grid connection context
context:power_readiness.description: Evidence about supporting power infrastructure. Does not establish data-centre construction status or energized capacity.

context:geometry_identity.label: Geometry identity context
context:geometry_identity.description: Context used to tie the geometry to the named site. Not a status source.

context:site_distinctness.label: Site distinctness context
context:site_distinctness.description: Context used to establish that the site is distinct from the other sites in the Atlas.

context:source_location_identity.label: Source location context
context:source_location_identity.description: Context tying the source's stated location to the site.

context:campus_address_identity.label: Campus address context
context:campus_address_identity.description: Context tying a published address to the campus.

context:project_context.label: Project context
context:project_context.description: Background context for the project. Creates no claim.

context:project_and_campus_identity.label: Project and campus identity context
context:project_and_campus_identity.description: Context tying the project to its parent campus.

operating_model.label: Operating model
operating_model.description: Source of the published operating model.

workload.label: Workload
workload.description: Source of a published workload classification.

workload_scope:intended.label: Intended workload
workload_scope:intended.description: Supports a workload classification scoped as intended, not operational.

workload_scope:operational.label: Operational workload
workload_scope:operational.description: Supports a workload classification scoped as operational.

workload_scope:unknown.label: Workload scope unknown
workload_scope:unknown.description: Supports a workload classification whose deployment scope is not established.

typed_metric:critical_it_mw.label: Critical IT load observation
typed_metric:critical_it_mw.description: Supports a typed critical IT load observation.

typed_metric:gross_facility_mw.label: Gross facility power observation
typed_metric:gross_facility_mw.description: Supports a typed gross facility power observation.

typed_metric:grid_connection_mw.label: Grid connection observation
typed_metric:grid_connection_mw.description: Supports a typed grid connection observation.

typed_metric:generation_nameplate_mw.label: Generation nameplate observation
typed_metric:generation_nameplate_mw.description: Supports a typed generation nameplate observation.

typed_metric:annual_energy_mwh.label: Annual energy observation
typed_metric:annual_energy_mwh.description: Supports a typed annual energy observation.

typed_metric:pue.label: PUE observation
typed_metric:pue.description: Supports a typed power usage effectiveness observation.

context:multi_site_program.label: Context: Multi Site Program
context:multi_site_program.description: Source for the context multi site program claim, retaining its original scope and date.

imported:geometry.label: Imported: Geometry
imported:geometry.description: Source for the imported geometry claim, retaining its original scope and date.

imported:record.description: Source for the imported record claim, retaining its original scope and date.

imported:status.label: Imported: Status
imported:status.description: Source for the imported status claim, retaining its original scope and date.

metric:accelerators.description: Source for the metric accelerators claim, retaining its original scope and date.

metric:buildings.description: Source for the metric buildings claim, retaining its original scope and date.

metric:power_capacity.description: Source for the metric power capacity claim, retaining its original scope and date.

user.description: A user of the facility's capacity.

hyperscale_lease.description: Built by a developer for lease to a hyperscale provider.

colocation.description: Space, power and cooling offered to customers.

wholesale_colocation.description: Colocation sold in large blocks to few customers.

retail_colocation.label: Retail colocation
retail_colocation.description: Colocation sold in smaller units to many customers.

enterprise_private.label: Enterprise private
enterprise_private.description: Built for a single enterprise's own use.

sovereign_research.label: Sovereign research
sovereign_research.description: National or sovereign research computing facility.

unknown.label: Unknown
unknown.description: The operating model is not established by the selected evidence.

greenfield.label: Greenfield
greenfield.description: New development on an undeveloped site.

expansion.label: Expansion
expansion.description: Expansion of an existing facility or campus.

retrofit.label: Retrofit

unknown.label: Unknown
unknown.description: The selected evidence does not establish the development type.

campus.label: Campus
campus.description: The source geometry describes the parent campus.

facility.label: Facility
facility.description: The source geometry describes a facility on the campus.

building.label: Building
building.description: The source geometry describes a building.

project.label: Project
project.description: The source geometry describes the project itself.

address_area.label: Address area
address_area.description: The source geometry describes an address or statistical area, not the site itself.

host_estate.label: Host estate
host_estate.description: The source geometry describes the estate or industrial park that hosts the site, not the site itself.

site_count.label: Site count
site_count.description: Physical sites in the checkpoint compared with the target.

additional_site_count.label: Additional sites
additional_site_count.description: Sites added beyond the frozen baseline preview compared with the target.

country_count.label: Countries
country_count.description: Countries represented compared with the minimum.

non_us_site_count.label: Non-US sites
non_us_site_count.description: Sites outside the United States compared with the minimum.

maximum_single_country_share.label: Largest country share
maximum_single_country_share.description: Share of sites in the most represented country compared with the maximum allowed.

imagery_outcomes_complete.label: Imagery outcomes
imagery_outcomes_complete.description: Projects with a recorded imagery review outcome compared with all projects.

blind_review.label: Blind review
blind_review.description: Independent blind re-review of a sample of projects: sample size and agreements.

clean_clone_rebuild.label: Clean-clone rebuild
clean_clone_rebuild.description: Whether the checkpoint has been rebuilt byte-for-byte from a clean public clone.

publication_authorized.label: Publication authorized
publication_authorized.description: Whether the checkpoint is authorized for final publication.

not_reviewed.label: Not reviewed against imagery
not_reviewed.description: No imagery review is recorded for this project. Its status rests only on the dated authoritative source.

not_reviewed_for_core_preview.label: Not reviewed against imagery
not_reviewed_for_core_preview.description: No imagery review is recorded for this project. Its status rests only on the dated authoritative source.

first_party_contractor_drone_imagery_pre.label: Publisher or contractor drone imagery, not independently verified
first_party_contractor_drone_imagery_pre.description: The publisher or its contractor has published drone imagery of the works. The Atlas did not verify it independently and does not redistribute it. No construction, completion or progress claim is made from imagery.

tracked_blind_clear_locally_unsealed_ide.label: Blind imagery review: clear visible change, identity link not public
tracked_blind_clear_locally_unsealed_ide.description: A blind satellite-image comparison recorded clear visible change, but the link between the reviewed images and this project exists only in unpublished local files. Recorded for follow-up only. No construction, completion or progress claim is made from imagery.

tracked_blind_ambiguous_locally_unsealed.label: Blind imagery review: ambiguous, identity link not public
tracked_blind_ambiguous_locally_unsealed.description: A blind satellite-image comparison was ambiguous (for example partly obscured), and the link between the reviewed images and this project exists only in unpublished local files. No construction, completion or progress claim is made from imagery.
